Observed 2026-09-13 in a Claude Code (fable) session on Meander, a repo running BOTH surfaces at once: a repo-level .mcp.json (stdio rvr mcp-server, env {}) plus rvr from the Bash tool. Its CLAUDE.md tells agents MCP is the safest write path, and that wording is OUR scaffold (src/commands/claude-md.ts), which contradicts the 07-22 fleet policy in [[project.surfaceStrategy]] (shell agents use the CLI uniformly).

ATTRIBUTION HOLDS ON BOTH SURFACES by env inheritance: RVR_AGENT_NAME=fable from the ~/.claude/settings.json env block reaches the Bash shell AND the stdio MCP server process, so this machine's audit log reads cli/fable 2976 rows, mcp/fable 157; the 13-row rollout gap in [[context.crossMachineDataset]] finding 3 has closed here. Remaining nulls: cli/null ended 09-04 (the human at a terminal); mcp/null runs to 09-12 and is Codex over MCP (its shell_environment_policy names the agent, its MCP server config does not); Codex's name also drifted, sol in July, codex in September.

SESSIONS FRAGMENT on 1.3.0: a random id per CLI invocation, another per MCP server process, never joined. Claude Code exports CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID (with CLAUDECODE=1, CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT=cli, CLAUDE_PID) into BOTH the Bash shell and the MCP server process. #207 (PR #219, unreleased until 1.4.0) adopts it when RVR_SESSION is unset; both surfaces resolve the id through the same getSessionId, so one session's CLI and MCP rows should join under one id (not yet observed in a log) — [[context.sessionDetection]]. Until 1.4.0 is installed: set RVR_SESSION to the CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID value on every rvr call. See [[project.cliAgentParity]], [[arch.telemetry]].
